items.title: Iranian accused of hacking American universities extradited from Montenegro
items.summary: An Iranian national accused by the U.S. of taking part in dozens of breaches involving the theft of academic data and intellectual property has been extradited from Montenegro.

items.title: OpenAI software attempted to secretly scrape data from dozens of prominent websites
items.summary: The findings, released Thursday by Asymmetric Security, are just the latest example of rogue behavior spurred by OpenAI’s software.

items.title: Researchers find Chinese hacking campaigns targeting AI firms, Asian governments
items.summary: Two separate reports by cybersecurity companies highlight China-linked hacking operations, including a phishing campaign that impersonated Western experts.

items.title: Police disrupt KillSec ransomware, arrest suspected teenage leader
items.summary: European police said raids against the KillSec ransomware-as-a-service operation included the arrest of a high-profile teen suspect.

items.title: Cyberattack on major Polish invoicing platform exposes customer data
items.summary: One of Poland’s major online invoicing platforms suffered a data breach that may have exposed information belonging to its users, their customers and business partners.
